subject.title: Inject sibling agent list into session system prompt

question: Should OpenClaw expose sibling-agent roster metadata to model-visible session context, and should that exposure be automatic prompt text or an allowlist-aware discovery tool result?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes what operator-authored agent metadata and cross-agent permission state becomes visible to an agent, which needs maintainer product and security-boundary intent.

options.title: Prefer gated tool discovery
options.body: Expose only authorized, bounded sibling metadata through `agents_list` or a similar tool and avoid automatic prompt injection by default.

options.title: Inject a minimal prompt roster
options.body: Add a compact prompt section for allowed siblings if maintainers accept the token, cache, and metadata-exposure cost.

options.title: Reject core roster exposure
options.body: Keep current id-only discovery and explicit docs/config if maintainers do not want this metadata model-visible in core.

recommendation.title: Prefer gated tool discovery
recommendation.body: Expose only authorized, bounded sibling metadata through `agents_list` or a similar tool and avoid automatic prompt injection by default.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest history signal on `agents_list`, multi-agent routing, and session-tool security boundaries.
